info.name: Report the current system status.

params.name: mode
params.description: Select details to return. "quick" are the details that can be answered without much load on the system. "slow" also includes some resource-intensive queries.

items.docs: Must be a system administrator to call this with any mode other than basic.

info.name: Perform a variety of system checks to verify that all is well.

params.name: progress
params.description: Whether to record progress on this task.

items.docs: Must be a system administrator to call this.  This verifies and corrects some issues, such as incorrect folder sizes.

info.name: Get the value of a system setting, or a list of them.

params.name: key
params.description: The key identifying this setting.

params.name: list
params.description: A JSON list of keys representing a set of settings to return.

params.name: default
params.description: If "none", return a null value if a setting is currently the default value. If "default", return the default value of the setting(s).

items.docs: Must be a system administrator to call this.

info.name: Get a list of uploads that have not been finished.

params.name: uploadId
params.description: List only a specific upload.

params.name: userId
params.description: Restrict listing uploads to those started by a specific user.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Restrict listing uploads to those within a specific folder or item.

params.name: assetstoreId
params.description: Restrict listing uploads within a specific assetstore.

params.name: minimumAge
params.description: Restrict listing uploads to those that are at least this many days old.

params.name: includeUntracked
params.description: Some assetstores can have partial uploads that are no longer in the Girder database.  If this is True, include all of them (only filtered by assetstoreId) in the result list.

params.name: limit
params.description: Result set size limit.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset into result set.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the result set by.

params.name: sortdir
params.description: Sort order: 1 for ascending, -1 for descending.

items.docs: Must be a system administrator to call this.

info.name: Discard uploads that have not been finished.

params.name: uploadId
params.description: Clear only a specific upload.

params.name: userId
params.description: Restrict clearing uploads to those started by a specific user.

params.name: parentId
params.description: Restrict clearing uploads to those within a specific folder or item.

params.name: assetstoreId
params.description: Restrict clearing uploads within a specific assetstore.

params.name: minimumAge
params.description: Restrict clearing uploads to those that are at least this many days old.

params.name: includeUntracked
params.description: Some assetstores can have partial uploads that are no longer in the Girder database.  If this is True, remove all of them (only filtered by assetstoreId).

items.docs: Must be a system administrator to call this. This frees resources that were allocated for the uploads and clears the uploads from database.
